newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GRANADE THROWN ON CAR LOT IN BOMB-WEARY BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: GRANADE THROWN ON CAR LOT IN BOMB-WEARY BUDAPEST.

text.p: A hand grenade was thrown into a suburban car dealership early on Monday causing up to one million forints in damage, in the latest of a spate of bomb attacks in Budapest, city police said.
No one was injured in 4:30 a.m. attack by a Yugoslav-made M 85 granade, spokesman Laszlo Katai told Reuters.

He added that police are investigating whether the attack was linked to the recent series of shootings and blasts in one man was killed, two more severely injured, and large amount of property damage was caused. The attacks have been linked to a struggles between local criminal gangs.
